subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: James Joyce and the Epiphany
description: A 60-second lesson on James Joyce and the Epiphany.

hook.text: James Joyce built every story in Dubliners around a single moment of sudden, devastating self-awareness.

buildup.text: In The Dead, a man discovers at a party that his wife's deepest love was for a boy who died years before.

discovery.text: Joyce called these moments epiphanies: flashes where a character suddenly sees the truth of their own life.

twist.text: Every publisher in Dublin rejected Dubliners, and it took nine years of battles before it was finally printed.

climax.text: Joyce's epiphany technique became the foundation of the modern literary short story worldwide.

punchline.text: The book Dublin rejected defined the modern short story.

quiz.question: What is a Joycean epiphany in short fiction?
options: A sudden flash where a character sees the truth of their own life
A happy ending after a difficult journey
